name: tool_wide_drift
description: A fault whose correct answer is a *tool*, not a chamber. Every fault in the Phase 1 library targets one chamber, so 'attribute at chamber grain' has never been tested against the case where chamber grain is the wrong answer: here both chambers of one etch tool drift together, because the cause is shared — a common gas supply, a common calibration — and an engine that insists on naming a single chamber will split the evidence in half and name neither. The target states a tool and no chamber, which the scenario contract treats as a different declaration rather than a defaulted one, and the latent engine applies one drive to every chamber the target resolves to. It pairs deliberately with `parameter_drift`, which puts the same mechanism on one chamber of this same tool: the two differ in grain, severity and ramp, so the contrast between them is the grain question with everything else held as close as the library can hold it.
